method: nonblind parent static review; subjective 0–5; 15 full-size final images inspected

ablation.rationale: Separated scene detaches details and numbers wrap.

candidate_v1.rationale: Layer relation is clear; identifiers wrap; flat repeated tiers remain serviceable.

candidate_v2.rationale: All identifiers and roles readable; content bound; composition remains a basic 2D schematic.

transfer_v1.rationale: Four semantic layers transfer; carrier numbers wrap.

transfer_v2.rationale: Identifiers fit; Vietnamese roles readable; same schematic visual language.

visual_counts.method: human count, not automatic text-layout measurement
